race.description: Park Fuelled To Win F&M Mdn Hcp
race.comment: BORN TO FLY (6) started $2.50 favourite on debut over 1100m at Rosehill three weeks ago but after racing wide without cover she failed to come on. Draws a nice gate here and can turn things around. ROSIE ROUGE (3) was a $1.7 million yearling purchase who debuted over 1100m at Warwick Farm in February 2025 and failed. It has been a stop-start operation since but three very good trials since 11 September suggest she is back on track. EXTREMELY CHIC (2) returns after a five-month spell. Ran two nice races at Canterbury in the maiden prep, albeit on wet tracks. Should be competitive at this level. Waller's first starter ATHENARA (4) trialled well at Rosehill recently and is one to keep an eye on. Another newcomer in HOME AND DRY (8) won a recent Rosehill trial and is sure to be popular with punters.
